boundary: The positive upper capillary cut remains required at structural penetrations. Blind central stock does not by itself qualify perimeter air/moisture seals, heat flow, complete steel execution or site uplift. Four outer joints and four court rods do not imply only eight piles can see tension. Full pile/soil, differential settlements, actual starter bends/hoops and temporary stability remain unresolved.

DPC.route: Studs with full-strength forged/rolled M24 transitions to twelve H20s enter separate blind bores above and below the four-bar blocks. A 26mm-or-greater imperforate middle remains. Vertical bar forces go through thick stock to their aligned opposite bars; gross concrete bears across plate/block faces. A shop-butt-welded 20mm web makes one L moisture plane. Positive key faces carry in-plane horizontal load; residual sensitivity tested through twelve embedded/captive studs. No friction or field welding below grade. Demand actual certified compatible threaded bar/plate material, tensile pullout/fatigue/thread-root/bearing/splitting, fabrication/air-edge/thermal details before adoption.
